sql.if: AND ( (CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_name, o.buyer_name) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) END) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR (CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) END) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql:
SELECT t.buyer_id AS user_id, MAX(t.buyer_name) AS user_name, MAX(t.buyer_phone) AS phone, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN t.signed_total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_purchase_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN t.signed_payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN t.signed_receipt_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_receipt_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{todayEnd} THEN t.signed_recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_share_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{yesterdayEnd} THEN t.signed_total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_purchase_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{yesterdayEnd} THEN t.signed_payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND t.create_time <= #{yesterdayEnd} THEN t.signed_receipt_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_receipt_amount FROM ( SELECT o.create_time, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_id, o.buyer_id) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_id, o.buyer_id) END AS buyer_id, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_name, o.buyer_name) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) END AS buyer_name, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN COALESCE(l.prev_buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) ELSE COALESCE(l.buyer_phone, o.buyer_phone) END AS buyer_phone, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.total_amount ELSE o.total_amount END AS signed_total_amount, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -o.recommend_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -o.recommend_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE o.recommend_amount END AS signed_recommend_amount, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -l.payment_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -l.payment_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN l.payment_amount ELSE l.payment_amount END AS signed_payment_amount, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN -l.receipt_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 1 THEN -l.receipt_amount WHEN l.operate_type = 3 AND split.n = 2 THEN l.receipt_amount ELSE l.receipt_amount END AS signed_receipt_amount FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n) split ON l.operate_type = 3 WHERE 1 = 1 AND o.create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND o.create_time <= #{todayEnd}
) t GROUP BY t.buyer_id, t.buyer_name, t.buyer_phone ORDER BY t.buyer_id DESC
